LanguageData.RWS_LandformHomesDesc: Highest number of active home maps seen in a successful save, measured separately for each recorded landform.
LanguageData.RWS_SprinklerGrowthDesc: Counts sprinkler boosts that increased plant growth, by plant type.
LanguageData.RWS_HospitalAdmissionsDesc: Counts patients registered by the Hospital mod at a home map.
LanguageData.RWS_MultistageEventsDesc: Counts events that ended after their final stage, by event type.
LanguageData.RWS_AwakenedDryadsDesc: Counts awakened dryads that actually spawned at a home map, by kind.
LanguageData.RWS_ArchonReturnsDesc: Counts player Archons that actually returned to a home map from transcendence.
LanguageData.RWS_StingerImplantsDesc: Counts Alpha Genes stinger implants that changed the target’s genes or xenotype.
LanguageData.RWS_PuppetsCreatedDesc: Counts new puppets successfully linked to a player puppeteer.
LanguageData.RWS_PuppetTransfersDesc: Counts successful transfers of a player puppeteer’s mind to another pawn.
LanguageData.RWS_VFECatchesDesc: Counts items spawned by player fishing jobs in Vanilla Fishing Expanded without Odyssey, by item type. Work by prisoners in the colony's custody (possible with some mods) is included.
